title: Applying the Integral Test to a Logarithmic Denominator
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine the convergence or divergence of sum_{n=2}^oo 1 / (n ln n).

steps.title: Check Integral Test Conditions
steps.mathExpression: f(x) = \frac{1}{x \ln x} > 0, \quad f'(x) = -\frac{\ln x + 1}{(x \ln x)^2} < 0 \quad \forall x \ge 2
steps.explanation: f is continuous, positive, and decreasing on [2, oo).

steps.title: Evaluate Improper Integral
steps.explanation: Substitute u = ln(x) to integrate 1/u du.

steps.title: Conclude Divergence
steps.explanation: Since the integral diverges, the series diverges.
